content:
{a}Nane cocha, {G}nane {C}gad,
{F}  mi kinel man{C}ge o {A}dad,
{d}sar me dzava {a}pal o rom,
{E}  mi kinel man{a}ge o rom.

{a}Lai lai lai lai lai {G}lai lai lai {C}lai lai.
{F}Lai lai lai lai {C}lai lai lai {A}lai lai.
/: {d}Lai lai lai lai {a}lai lai lai lai lai lai lai.
{E}Lai lai lai lai {a}lai lai lai. :/

Dado mamo cin cena,
o la cena somnakune.
sat ru mange na cineha,
na basavna o chaja.

Ge'om me androda sados,
pirkerdzome leskero,
pokerdzome tro sero.
Kaj tu kames mro jilo.

(Letzte wie erste)
title: Nane cocha nane gad
